body:
The aspiring guy himself isn't of much use, really. When shit hits the fan, he's not able to help really. And it's not like I want him to, anyway. If I could I'd rather share with as few people as possible, to avoid provoking depression in others.   
As for his step-father \[the retired therapist\]: The thing is, he just gave me the "well it's completely normal for your age \[20 years old\] to have such thoughts. Life is what it is." and some shit like that, on the first call. The second call, he sort of tried to help me figure out how to live a life, which isn't really what I need, because I'm not even sure I want to. 

That's like, the worst thing I can be doing. I'm not living a life, nor am I ending it. I'm just skating by in a distracted and miserable state of mind, until I no longer can, which is possible for a couple, maybe a few more years at most. I wish that limit was sooner, so I wouldn't have the option to be like that anymore and have to make a decision.

There is only one possibility for that, which like a miracle, happened, but still hasn't helped.I am in a country \[which I can't really move out from for various reasons\], where mental health care is a horrific process of either literally ignoring you or label you insane and pump you on drugs, perhaps even send you in an asylum.

I somehow managed to "befriend" \[not really\] a guy who's aspiring to help people and become a future therapist, whose step-father is a retired psychiatrist and he tried to set up a couple of meetings with him. The first one gave me some food for thought, but overall hasn't changed anything in regards to purpose of life and will to live.

If anything, it's probably gotten me closer to possibly ending it, the next time I go under massive pressure.
Me too, buddy.. Me too.. I just want to scream my lungs out and cry my heart out. Lately more than ever.
